messages:
maria (AE): Kickoff for Acme trial — need to align on POC success criteria, golden prompts, and outstanding security/pricing asks. Target start: next Mon. Who can drive the eval harness?
sam (SE): I can own harness + scoring. Need final use-case list & sample data. What's the primary metric? latency or quality?
jit (Solutions Eng): Primary is extraction accuracy for invoice fields + latency SLO 300ms p50. Suggest golden set = 120 samples (edge+happy path) + 20 adversarial regressions.
olivia (Sales Eng): Pricing Q: customer asked if Dedicated reserved nodes are required for 10k reqs/day or if hosted burst works. Also SSO/KMS for private telemetry — security asked for answers.
derek (Security): SSO via SAML OK. KMS integration requires a SOC-2 addendum + config doc. Also need network diagram and data-flow for PII.
sam (SE): For golden prompts, propose categories: normal extraction, weird formats, OCR noise, multi-page. Example prompts:
```
Extract: vendor, invoice_date, total_amount
Text: <invoice OCR text>
```
Scoring: field-level F1; overall pass if avg F1 >= 0.92; regression gate: nightly runs fail if any shard drops >3%.
maria (AE): Good. Can we compress into acceptance matrix? Who'll own runbook for regressions and alerts?
jit (Solutions Eng): I'll write runbook. Estimated 2 days for harness + 1 day for runbook. Will need access to sample data + repo perms.
olivia (Sales Eng): On pricing, propose 3 options: (1) Hosted pay-as-you-go (token-based), (2) Dedicated monthly commit (35% discount), (3) Private deploy (enterprise license). I'll draft numbers and share.
derek (Security): Quick blocker: customer requires encryption-at-rest with BYOK KMS and audit logs for model inputs. Need confirmation from infra.
infra-bot: Dedicated quota check: allocated GPUs available in us-west-2: 6/6. Request ticket if you need >6.
sam (SE): OK I'll scaffold harness. Action items:
- sam: initial harness + scoring script by Thu
- jit: runbook + infra access by Fri
- olivia: pricing options by Wed
- derek: provide security checklist answers by Tue
maria (AE): Thanks team. I'll set up a follow-up on Wed 10am PT. Sharing golden prompt seed in #private-data shortly. :thumbsup:
